scope: Drawing Intelligence only; RAB and schedule excluded
current_wave_goal: Transform technical Drawing Intelligence output into evidence-backed, human-readable work items aligned with the existing frontend.

phases.name: Secure Drawing Ingestion
phases.completed_in_current_system: Source checksum, manifest, PDF/raster routing, CAD fail-closed.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Encrypted/malware quarantine and enterprise upload resume remain production gates.

phases.name: Modality Routing and Quality Profiling
phases.completed_in_current_system: Vector/raster/hybrid decision and explainable page profile; PLHUT 88/88 routed.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Zone-level learned routing on mixed scan/vector documents remains.

phases.name: Canonical Coordinate System
phases.completed_in_current_system: Normalized evidence and viewport-safe geometry are versioned.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Full DWG world-coordinate round trip awaits production CAD adapter.

phases.name: Native Vector Primitive Extraction
phases.completed_in_current_system: Native PDF text/vector primitives are the deterministic spine.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Dedicated hatch/layer schema and CAD-layer fidelity remain.

phases.name: Sheet Identity and Page Semantics
phases.completed_in_current_system: Human scopes L1/L2/Atap/Fondasi/Area Tapak; no invented floor defaults.
phases.remaining_production_gate: More title-block families and revision-conflict evaluation remain.

phases.name: Plan Zones and Layout Intelligence
phases.completed_in_current_system: Drawing/title/legend/table/note zoning prevents obvious legend counts.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Learned layout candidate generator and editable zone UI remain.

phases.name: Engineering Text, Dimensions, Tables and OCR
phases.completed_in_current_system: Native text first; OCR fallback; profile dimensions no longer become opening dimensions.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Engineering OCR ensemble and character-level benchmark remain.

phases.name: Canonical DEM Evidence and Repair
phases.completed_in_current_system: DEM/native evidence fusion and conservative repair; no fabricated evidence.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Strict typed DEM gate for all new providers remains rollout work.

phases.name: Project Vocabulary
phases.completed_in_current_system: Context-ranked vocabulary; code identity uses definition source, discipline and sheet type.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Vocabulary conflict-resolution UI remains.

phases.name: Cross-Sheet Entity Resolution
phases.completed_in_current_system: Discipline-scoped links join occurrences to schedules/details; K2 joins to 250×600 mm.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Generalized entity-resolution metrics require a second project.

phases.name: Vector Symbol Descriptors
phases.completed_in_current_system: Stroke/topology descriptors and explainable candidates exist.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Per-class precision/recall and rotation/scale stress corpus remain.

phases.name: Project-Specific Similarity
phases.completed_in_current_system: Positive/negative project prototypes with versioned storage exist.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Distributed persistence and multi-user conflict handling remain.

phases.name: Area Segmentation
phases.completed_in_current_system: Vector-assisted One-Click Area returns review candidates, never final quantity.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Nested voids, raster masks and complex hatch reconstruction remain.

phases.name: Line Topology
phases.completed_in_current_system: One-Click Line and connected-path baseline exist.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Curves, occlusion and noisy scan topology require broader fixtures.

phases.name: Geometry Reconstruction
phases.completed_in_current_system: Connected vector geometry is deterministic and evidence-linked.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Object topology validation and CAD-scale round trip remain.

phases.name: Work-Item Maturation
phases.completed_in_current_system: 64 human-readable items, 5 clarifications, 4 audit-suppressed candidates; no raw JSON in primary delivery.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Civil/MEP item taxonomy expansion requires additional project drawings.

phases.name: Human Review Queue
phases.completed_in_current_system: Versioned accept/reject/edit ledger, canonical storage, batched review and frontend actions.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Database-backed multi-reviewer locking remains a production gate.

phases.name: Active Learning and Project Memory
phases.completed_in_current_system: Accepted/rejected prototypes persist locally with legacy-key fallback.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Training/re-ranking evaluation across projects remains.

phases.name: Frontend Delivery
phases.completed_in_current_system: Existing visual design preserved; human item cards, level labels, evidence, blockers and review actions wired.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Full browser E2E awaits pnpm dependencies and running services.

phases.name: Benchmark, Observability and Release Gates
phases.completed_in_current_system: 19/19 package, 10/10 human, 18/18 user-ready; 88 pages; no live AI calls.
phases.remaining_production_gate: Universal production release requires object-level ground truth, second project, Node build and PostgreSQL/pgvector CI.

Full Node/Vitest/typecheck/build unavailable because pnpm is absent
